item.title: Service Law January 2026: A Look at Key Decisions of the Month
item.description: Bringing together significant service law rulings from the Supreme Court and various High Courts, this roundup offers brief summaries of the month’s important cases along with references to related roundups. The post Service Law January 2026: A Look at Key Decisions of the Month appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Fatal fall from train is an untoward incident, not self-inflicted injury: Bombay HC directs Railways to pay Rs 4 lakh compensation
item.description: “In matters governed by beneficial legislation, the benefit of doubt should go in the person’s favour who has met with the accident. Railways could have supported its case by examining the co-passenger or guard or by leading expert evidence to show that a person falling from a moving train could not get entangled in its wheels.” The post Fatal fall from train is an untoward incident, not self-inflicted injury: Bombay HC directs Railways to pay Rs 4 lakh compensation appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Saying ‘go away and die’ in heat of passion not abetment of suicide under S. 306 IPC; Kerala HC discharges accused
item.description: “When the deceased came to know that the accused was about to marry another woman, she inquired about the same over the phone, and enraged by the query, the accused scolded the deceased and said, ‘go away and die’. The deceased feeling mentally disturbed, jumped into a well along with her daughter and committed suicide.” The post Saying ‘go away and die’ in heat of passion not abetment of suicide under S. 306 IPC; Kerala HC discharges accused appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi HC directs Bollywood actor Rajpal Yadav to surrender in cheque bounce case; cites repeated settlement defaults
item.description: “This Court finds no justification to continue the indulgence granted to Rajpal Yadav earlier, especially in the case as the present one, where he himself has admitted the liability and undertaken to repay the amount.” The post Delhi HC directs Bollywood actor Rajpal Yadav to surrender in cheque bounce case; cites repeated settlement defaults appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Allahabad HC directs Revision of Merit List in CLAT 2026; Upholds Expert View Recognising Two Answers for One Question
